title: Keynote: Indonesia’s Nickel Ambitions & Downstream Integration
gist: Member-only video page for a 22-minute Benchmark Week 2026 keynote by APNI Secretary General Meidy Katrin Lengkey on Indonesia's nickel policy, production and downstream integration. Indonesia's strategy is to move beyond raw material exports and become an integrated battery materials hub. No transcript or figures are given.

insights.claim: Indonesia's strategy, as presented by the Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI), is to move beyond raw material exports to become an integrated battery materials hub.
insights.speaker: Meidy Katrin Lengkey, Secretary General, Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI)
insights.so_what: Indonesia's push to keep processing at home shapes where nickel and cathode value is captured and where foreign investors build plants.
insights.quote: Indonesia’s strategy for moving beyond raw material exports to become an integrated battery materials hub.

insights.claim: APNI Secretary General Meidy Katrin Lengkey gave the keynote on Indonesian nickel policy, production and downstream integration at Benchmark Week 2026 on Nov 10, 2026. The page is member-only and gives no production figures or policy details.
insights.speaker: Meidy Katrin Lengkey, Secretary General, Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI)
insights.so_what: Specific Indonesian policy moves (quotas, export rules) that would move nickel prices are not disclosed here.

insights.claim: Benchmark's cathode market update at Benchmark Week 2026 covered cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional pricing arbitrage between them.
insights.speaker: Meidy Katrin Lengkey, Secretary General, Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI)
insights.so_what: Cathode capacity is spreading beyond China to Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional price gaps create arbitrage that affects producer margins.
insights.quote: Cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, regional pricing arbitrage, and which producers are leading global expansion.

insights.claim: Benchmark Week 2026 included a Benchmark copper market update framing copper's role in electrification around supply constraints and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres.
insights.speaker: Meidy Katrin Lengkey, Secretary General, Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI)
insights.so_what: Copper demand is being linked to datacentres and grid build-out as well as EVs, broadening the demand case beyond autos.
insights.quote: Copper’s role in electrification: supply constraints and demand from EVs, grid infrastructure and datacentres.

source_meta.author: Meidy Katrin Lengkey, Secretary General, Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI)
